newsitem.title: USA: Entergy ends talks with NY Power Authority.
newsitem.headline: Entergy ends talks with NY Power Authority.

text.p: Entergy Corp said Tuesday negotiations with the New York Power Authority on a contract for Entergy to provide management services for the authority's two nuclear power plants have ended.

"Despite the parties' best efforts, they were unable to agree on the business terms of the contract -- particularly the allocation of costs and financial incentives between the two sides," Entergy said in a statement.
Thorough assessments of the plants by Entergy identified no major barriers to the agreement which would have been the first of its kind in the nation, it added.
Entergy said its team "was impressed by improvements made by NYPA at both plants -- Indian Point 3 in Westchester County and Fitzpatrick in Oswego County."
It noted that, with continued progress, both plants should be ready to succeed in the coming competitive environment.

NYPA and Entergy have concluded their negotiations on amicable terms. Both sides recognized from the start that their pioneering initiative would be difficult - with success far from assured, the company said.
"They believe their experience will benefit utilities that pursue similar relationships in the future," it added.
Entergy said it will seek additional opportunities to provide its management expertise to other nuclear plant operators.
